dialog1.1: Hello! Welcome to my portfolio! My name is Victor, I have been a web developer for 3 years.
dialog1.2: In reality, this is not exactly a game...
dialog1.3: It is an experience created with Three.js, inspired by the classic Pokémon games for the Nintendo DS.
dialog1.4: By exploring this world, you will find projects, technologies, and a bit of my journey as a developer.
dialog1.5: Oh, and a warning! This adventure is still under development. Therefore, new areas, projects, and features
dialog1.6: are being added gradually, so it's worth coming back from time to time to see the news!

dialog1.1: Hello, did you know that you can choose which Pokémon will follow you around?
dialog1.2: Just press the 'x' button, go to the Pokémon menu, and put first the Pokémon you want to follow you!
